title: 第21章 静观其变
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
于是，路仙瑶见他们二人回来时，还多带了一人。

    她眉头微皱，一脸这是什么意思。

    “圣……姑娘恕罪！我等不该带人一同前行，但奈何这位道友非要跟着，还请姑娘责罚！”两名护卫见她心生不悦，立即下跪求责罚。

    路仙瑶交代过，在外人面前不能称呼她圣女，要改为姑娘。

    “圣姑娘，你不要责罚他们，我只是与同门走散了，一个人在这苍山里害怕，这才想跟着你们的，只要遇到我的同门，我立即离开，不逗留！”落迎婳说道。

    她见护卫称呼她为圣姑娘，便也跟着这么称呼她。

    路仙瑶当然知道单独一人行走在苍山危险，换做是她，也会寻人作伴。

    她也并非排斥这名女子，而是因为她身着是天鸣剑宗的弟子服。

    天鸣剑宗的标志性颜色，便是黄色。

    凡是天鸣剑宗的人，她都不喜欢！

    这是其一。

    其二，她方才刚进入苍山秘境时，险些被一道凌厉的剑气劈中，她以为是云鹤珏，但却是另有其人。

    而这名黄衣女子随后便出现，未免也太过于巧合了些……

    不过，路仙瑶方才只是远远瞧见她飞来，并没有瞧仔细，现下此女仔细瞧着，眉眼间竟和她妹妹有些相似……

    这不由得让她想起了在宇宙遥远另一端的妹妹。

    她和妹妹都是在福利院一同长大的，虽然不是血亲，但胜似血亲。

    可后来，妹妹因为恋爱脑，不顾她的劝阻，非要嫁给渣男，最后被渣男害死……

    也许是想到了妹妹，路仙瑶便同意了此女跟着他们，“行吧。”

    闻言，落迎婳欣喜地朝她躬身，“多谢圣姑娘，我一定一定不给你们添麻烦！”

    ……

    路仙瑶乘坐小飞舟，载着墨燃和落迎婳，以及四名护卫来到临渊沼泽。

    此地阴暗，浓雾笼罩，连鸟声都没有，安静得可怕。

    这片浓雾像是什么阵法似的，终日环绕在这片沼泽之地，诡异得很，要是没有母亲给的图纸，怕是要迷失了方向。

    但也就是在这片浓雾下方，有一株株泛着幽幽紫华的水莲。

    “这是……紫河花！”

    落迎婳惊喜道。
content_en:
So, when Lu Xianyao saw the two of them coming back, they brought one more person with them.

    She frowned slightly, wondering what this meant.

    "Holy... miss, forgive me! I shouldn't have brought anyone along with me, but this Taoist friend insists on following me, so I ask the girl to punish me!" Seeing that she was unhappy, the two guards immediately knelt down and begged for punishment.

    Lu Xianyao told her that she could not be called a saint in front of outsiders, but should be called a girl instead.

    "Saint girl, don't punish them. I just got separated from my fellow disciples. I was scared to be alone in Cangshan Mountain, so I wanted to follow you. As soon as I meet my fellow disciples, I will leave immediately and not stay!" Luo Yinghua said.

    When she saw the guard calling her the Holy Girl, she also called her that.

    Of course, Lu Xianyao knew that it was dangerous to walk alone on Cangshan Mountain. If it were her, she would also look for someone to keep her company.

    It was not that she rejected this woman, but because she was wearing the uniform of a disciple of the Tianming Sword Sect.

    The signature color of Tianming Sword Sect is yellow.

    She doesn't like anyone from the Tianming Sword Sect!

    This is one of them.

    Secondly, when she just entered the Cangshan secret realm, she was almost hit by a sharp sword energy. She thought it was Yun Hejue, but it was someone else.

    And the woman in yellow appeared later, which was too much of a coincidence...

    However, Lu Xianyao just saw her flying from a distance and didn't take a closer look. Now that the woman looked carefully, she actually had some similarities with her sister...

    This reminded her of her sister on the other side of the universe.

    She and her sister grew up together in the orphanage. Although they are not blood relatives, they are better than blood relatives.

    But later, because of her love obsession, her sister insisted on marrying the scumbag regardless of her dissuasion, and was eventually killed by the scumbag...

    Perhaps thinking of his sister, Lu Xianyao agreed to let the girl follow them, "Okay."

    Hearing this, Luo Yinghua bowed to her happily, "Thank you, holy girl, I will definitely not cause any trouble to you!"

    …

    Lu Xianyao took a small flying boat, carrying Mo Ran, Luo Yinghua, and four guards to Linyuan Swamp.

    The place was dark, shrouded in thick fog, not even the sound of birds, it was eerily quiet.

    This thick fog seems to be some kind of formation, surrounding this swampland all day long. It is very strange. Without the drawings given by my mother, I would have lost my way.

    But just below this thick fog, there are water lilies glowing with faint purple flowers.

    "This is... Purple River Flower!"

    Luo Yinghua said in surprise.
title_en: Chapter 21 Wait and see what happens
